name: Exterior Masonry CMU Block Filler
intent: Block filler for CMU walls. PCA P12 Level 2. Spray+backroll or heavy roller. Applied before primer.
doctrine: CMU block filler. PCA P12 Level 2 standard. Spray+backroll at 150 SF/hr (2-person crew, heaviest-body product). Heavy roller at 80 SF/hr (single operator, very slow). Not quality-optional. Module only in CMU scenarios.
